title: Authority partition: no competing control plane
summary: Intentions discover possibilities; legal/security/access gate admissibility; Job-to-Node Allocator owns placement leases; WLU owns capacity admission; Memory Fabric owns memory semantics; Migratable Job owns checkpoint, fencing, transfer and continuation; Queue Fabric carries observations and messages; Cloud Economics ranks eligible alternatives only.
invariants: Advertised price is never permission to provision.
Queue topic delivery is not authentication, migration success, or a placement lease.
An economic score cannot override a hard veto or missing freshness proof.
A read-only advisory never mutates native allocator, migration or accounting authorities.
Connect Selector is a future connector-neutral integration seam, not a compulsory new transport.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=IMPLEMENTED.

procedure: Obtain existing owners' current capability, policy and resource decisions.
Reject candidates with any hard constraint failure.
Rank economic alternatives after admissibility and preserve upstream object/evidence identity.
Hand off only a recommendation and explicit missing authority requirements.
